g.text: Intelligent Institutional Memory & Decision Traceability Platform (PS 1)
• Drag nodes • Trace connection branches between People, Documents, Decisions & Events
"On-premise co-location hardware lease reached EOL with an estimated $2.45M capital refresh required.
Catastrophic Black Friday capacity saturation proved on-prem cannot scale dynamically during traffic spikes."
Renew colocation lease with hardware refresh — $2.45M upfront Capex + 380% Black Friday risk.
Serverless only (AWS Lambda) — Rejected due to 15-minute OCR pipeline execution cap.
Hybrid private OpenStack — Rejected due to 4x engineering staffing overhead required.
Author: Dr. Elena Rostova • Ratified Aug 28, 2022
"Over a 36-month horizon, managed Kubernetes delivers a 31.4% net TCO reduction ($3.1M vs $4.5M)..."
"Why did we pivot to cloud-native Kubernetes in 2022?"
The organizational pivot to managed Kubernetes (DEC-101) was triggered by the Black Friday 2021 capacity failure (Incident #382),
where on-premise servers saturated at 99.8% with zero autoscaling. Dr. Elena Rostova authored RFC-042 demonstrating a 31.4% TCO savings.
"Inability to provision compute nodes in real-time caused cascade..."
If evidence is missing (e.g. "Acme Acquisition in 2020"), ALETHEIA explicitly reports Low Confidence (12%) instead of guessing.
